svg.title: Alphabet Streets, Pacific Palisades
svg.desc: Actual Los Angeles County parcel boundaries and named street centerlines around Fiske, Galloway and Hartzell Streets, between Albright Street and Bestor Boulevard. Neutral geometry, with no property conditions or rebuilding claims. Right margin reserved for separate illustrations.
svg.metadata: Sources: Los Angeles County Office of the Assessor; Countywide Address Management System (CAMS). Retrieved 2026-09-27. WGS84 geographic coordinates projected to Web Mercator for this plan. Provider terms: https://egis-lacounty.hub.arcgis.com/pages/terms-of-use . See provenance.json.

g.text: Parcel boundaries: LA County Assessor · street names and centerlines: LA County CAMS
Geographic context only. No addresses, building designs, or property conditions are shown.
